name: May 14 Hmong veterans and General Vang Pao remembrance
whatItMarks: The May 14, 1975 departure of General Vang Pao from Laos, remembered by Hmong American and Hmong-Lao veterans.

name: Hmong New Year (Minnesota)
dateRule: Set each year by the organizing groups. Hmong New Year celebrations traditionally follow the harvest; in Minnesota they run from about October to December, and each city or organization picks its own dates and venue.
